nodes.label: Owed REGISTER expansions queue
nodes.rationale: A queue so nothing is lost: cuts are drafted as reader prose now, and the actual register entries are authored when the pass reaches the Register, which M closes with last.

nodes.label: Subject-matter proof-of-work vs editorial residue
nodes.rationale: Workshop cut from reader prose is not all process residue: how a result was reached, what was tried and withdrawn, and what the correct method turned out to be are findings about the mathematics, owed to the subject-matter Register because that Register exists to show proof-of-work.

nodes.label: Ruling 27: two registers (subject-matter vs working)
nodes.rationale: The subject-matter Register is append-only and never edited, relocated or renumbered; reader-perspective audits and production findings go to WORKING-REGISTER.md, and a withdrawn result is corrected by a NEW entry citing the old rather than by removing anything.

nodes.label: R-01: Lambda as minimum set cover, exactly seven cells
nodes.rationale: The route from greedy upper bounds (12/11/12) to the exact minimum is itself the finding: prune-greedy overcounts because it fits its own failures, branch-and-bound gives 7, and the spread across heuristics (prune 12, cover 7, reverse-delete 40, LB 5, exact 7; spread 33) is the quantity that reports algorithm quality. The superseded greedy figures are cited, not deleted.

nodes.label: R-02: counting/coupling asymmetry (parent-count reading withdrawn)
nodes.rationale: The per-axis prune-greedy numbers were the heuristic's difficulty, not the index's cost; under set cover a two-parent axis costs about the same as a one-parent axis, so the parent-count-drives-cost reading is withdrawn and what survives is the counting/coupling asymmetry read through the seed.

nodes.label: R-03: seed = Caratheodory number + alphabet cost
nodes.rationale: Breadth of a product of d chains is d and a generating set must reach the breadth; the coefficient was in the bibliography, glossed and left - Caratheodory was never cited though Helly was, which is itself prior-art provenance worth recording as proof-of-work.

nodes.label: R-04: Freuder 1982 / Dechter 1992 mis-citation correction
nodes.rationale: Freuder's backtrack-free search at strong (w+1)-consistency is a different theorem from Dechter's local-to-global result at strong (w*+1)-consistency; the book had cited Freuder for Dechter's theorem, and the correction is itself a subject-matter finding about provenance.

nodes.label: R-05: erasure-code false start withdrawn (nothing is forced)
nodes.rationale: The unreconstructible-core reading is withdrawn: zero envelope elements are uniquely covered at every cap and at Lambda_9, so the four corner cells appear in every sampled seed without any being forced - a conditional misread as a necessity.
